g.text: PickCube SAC: continuous training versus checkpoint restart
Each point: 480 trajectories across evaluation seeds 7001/7002/7003. Error bars: sample SD across those seeds.
The step-1000 model is shared within each training seed. Two training seeds; no significance claim.
